rca_of_the_issue: CRM isolation root cause: two parallel router files (crm.py and crm_module.py) both declare /crm/contacts endpoints. server.py only includes crm_module_router (line 156); crm_router (line 62) is imported but never registered. Therefore the new JWT-based isolation written in crm.py never executes — FastAPI dispatches to crm_module.py's older handler which (a) does not save createdByUserId on POST, and (b) uses an unsafe query-param `isAdmin` check on GET that defaults to True and can be spoofed by any client. Reproduction: login as a non-admin rep user, GET /api/crm/contacts -> returns all contacts from all users including admin-owned ones. POST /api/crm/contacts -> response has no createdByUserId field. Mitigation: in /app/backend/server.py near line 156, add `api_router.include_router(crm_router)` BEFORE the crm_module_router line so FastAPI's first-match wins selects the secured router. Alternatively, delete crm.py and port the logic into crm_module.py. Decide based on which router is feature-complete (crm_module.py has totalValue calculation, notes endpoints, etc., that crm.py lacks).
